tenderSchedule.deptName: D.Devaraj Urs Backward Classes Development Corporation

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of Managing Director, D.Devaraj urs Backward classes Development Corporation, 16-D, 4th Floor, Devaraj Urs Bhavan, Millers Tank Bund Area, Vasanthanagar,

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Certificate issued by the employer certifying a satisfactory supply of sewing machines with motor of specification mentioned in the tender document as a prime contractor No JV supplies of quantity not less than 80 percentage of the requirement mentioned in this document i.e not less than 7395 nos of sewing machines in any one year of the last three years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 For Manufacturer. In case the tenderer is an Authorized Dealer, the tenderer shall upload a certificate issued by the Employer, certifying satisfactory supply of sewing machines with motors conforming to the specifications stipulated in the tender document. The certificate shall establish that the tenderer, as the Prime Contractor, has successfully supplied a quantity not less than 40 percentage of the total requirement specified in this tender document, i.e., not less than 3698 nos sewing machines, in any one year during the last three financial years, namely 2023-24, 2024-25, or 2025-26 For Dealer. And in case if the tender is an MSE Micro & Small Enterprises having a valid and active certificate then shall submit a certificate issued by employer certifying a satisfactory supply of sewing machines with motor of specification mentioned in the tender document as a prime contractor of quantity not less than 40 percentage of the requirement mentioned in this document i.e not less than 3698 nos of sewing machines in any one year of the last two years 2024-25 and 2025-26 For MSEs

Certificate from Competent Authority representing the ownership of the Firm Name should be uploaded. Additionally, a self-attested document representing the Proprietor /Managing Director Name, Full Address along with Official Mobile Number should be uploaded.

Tenderer, who is a Manufacturer should upload Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) certificate registered with the competent authority OR if the tenderer is an Authorized dealer of the OEM then shall upload Manufacturers Authorization form as per Section XIII)
The PAN Card of the Tenders/Firm should be uploaded
Tender offer form as per pro-forma given in Section-VIII should be uploaded
Tenderer shall upload a declaration as per Section XV.
Notarized Affidavit as per Section-XIV should be uploaded.
Tenderer/OEM/Authorized dealer should have sufficient service centers in Karnataka to cater the service needs of the supply mentioned in the document. Copy of the same should be uploaded.

Tenderer should upload a Certificate as per section XVI confirming the goods beings supplied are compliant to Technical specifications mentioned in section VI of this document. (Preferably having ISI / BIS standard).
GSTR3B Returns should be uploaded for the period from April-2026 to Sep-2026 (Last 6 Months Returns).
3 years Income Tax Returns for the Financial Year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 should be uploaded.
Goods and Service Tax Active Registration Certificate along with its Annexures should be uploaded.

The Certificate issued by Charted Accountant with UDIN representing Average Annual Financial Turnover of the tenderer having a value not less than estimated cost of the quantity in the Tender Document i.e not less than Rs. 16.04 Cr during the last 3 preceding financial years should be uploaded For Manufacturer. In case if the Tenderer is an Authorized dealer having valid and active Authorization certificate, then shall upload Certificate issued by Charted Accountant with UDIN representing Average Annual Financial Turnover of the tenderer having a value not less than 50 percentage of the estimated cost of the quantity in the Tender Document i.e not less than Rs. 8.02 Cr during the last 3 preceding financial years For Dealer. In case if the Tenderer is a MSEs Micro & Small Enterprises having valid and active MSEs registration certificate then shall upload Certificate issued by Charted Accountant with UDIN representing Average Annual Financial Turnover of the tenderer having a value not less than 50 percentage of the estimated cost of the quantity in the Tender Document i.e not less than Rs. 8.02 Cr during the last 2 preceding financial years For MSE. Above, condition is stipulated as per G.O Order no. FD 908 Exp-12/2019 Bengaluru Dated 21.07.2020 & KG-2 of KTPP. Bidders shall submit, Annual Turnover certificate, Profit & Loss Statement, Balance Sheet and Statement of Total Income Financial Statements with UDIN on all statements to authenticate the above figures. Bidders Manufacturers & Dealers are permitted to submit their financial statements for either of the following periods a. FY 2022-23 to FY 2024-25 or b. FY 2023-24 to FY 2025-26, wherever the financial statements for FY 2025-26 have been duly finalised and filed Bidders MSEs are permitted to submit their financial statements for either of the following periods a. FY 2023-24 to FY 2024-25 or b. FY 2024-25 to FY 2025-26, wherever the financial statements for FY 2025-26 have been duly finalised and filed Bidders may opt for either of the above periods, considering the higher turnover achieved during the respective five-year period, subject to submission of the relevant financial statements.
